caching.title: Cache application data with VersaTul.Caching
caching.description: Add in-process caching to a .NET application with VersaTul.Caching. Keep service code behind the cache provider contract and configure expiration for frequently used data.

streamers.title: Export .NET collections with VersaTul.Collection.Streamers
streamers.description: Export .NET collections to files, ZIP archives, email, or data readers with VersaTul.Collection.Streamers. Reuse formatting and serialization across forward-only output workflows.

compression.title: Create ZIP archives from streams with VersaTul.Compression
compression.description: Create or extract ZIP archives from named in-memory streams with VersaTul.Compression. Keep file names and content types alongside stream data in application workflows.

configuration-defaults.title: Bootstrap package settings with VersaTul.Configuration.Defaults
configuration-defaults.description: Bootstrap VersaTul package settings with ready-to-override values from VersaTul.Configuration.Defaults. Start with baseline keys and customize only environment-specific values.

configuration.title: Read typed application settings with VersaTul.Configurations
configuration.description: Read application settings through testable, strongly typed key/value contracts with VersaTul.Configurations. Keep configuration portable without the full .NET configuration stack.

contracts.title: Share reusable .NET contracts with VersaTul.Contracts
contracts.description: Define shared predicate, command, and query contracts with VersaTul.Contracts. Decouple application services from concrete implementations across VersaTul packages.

bulk.title: Model provider-neutral bulk imports with VersaTul.Data.Bulk
bulk.description: Model bulk imports and source-to-destination column mappings with VersaTul.Data.Bulk. Reuse a provider-neutral contract before selecting a database bulk-copy implementation.

data-contracts.title: Define repository interfaces with VersaTul.Data.Contracts
data-contracts.description: Define repository and unit-of-work interfaces with VersaTul.Data.Contracts. Keep application data services independent from EF Core and provider-specific packages.

efcore.title: Build EF Core repositories with VersaTul.Data.EFCore
efcore.description: Build reusable EF Core repositories with VersaTul.Data.EFCore. Share CRUD, DbContext commit, and rollback behavior across .NET application services.

file-reader.title: Read CSV and text into IDataReader with VersaTul.Data.FileReader
file-reader.description: Read CSV and delimited text into IDataReader workflows with VersaTul.Data.FileReader. Convert flat files for imports and bulk-copy pipelines without custom row adapters.

mongodb.title: Build typed MongoDB repositories with VersaTul.Data.MongoDB
mongodb.description: Build typed MongoDB repositories with VersaTul.Data.MongoDB. Centralize collection mapping and serialization instead of scattering MongoDB driver code through services.

mssql.title: Use SQL Server bulk copy with VersaTul.Data.MsSql
mssql.description: Run SQL Server commands, structured parameters, and transactional bulk imports with VersaTul.Data.MsSql. Add SQL Server-specific access alongside VersaTul.Data.Sql.

sql.title: Execute relational SQL with VersaTul.Data.Sql
sql.description: Execute SQL commands and stored procedures with VersaTul.Data.Sql. Reuse parameter handling, connection selection, and result mapping without choosing SQL Server alone.

display-attributes.title: Control exported columns with VersaTul.Display.Attributes
display-attributes.description: Control exported column names and ordering from model metadata with VersaTul.Display.Attributes. Shape tabular output without renaming C# model properties.

extensions.title: Add conversion helpers with VersaTul.Extensions
extensions.description: Add concise conversion and normalization helpers to .NET objects with VersaTul.Extensions. Use extension methods backed by VersaTul.Utilities and VersaTul.Object.Converters.

handler-file.title: Handle application files through VersaTul.Handler.File
handler-file.description: Read, write, and archive application files through testable interfaces with VersaTul.Handler.File. Keep paths, extensions, and stream operations behind file abstractions.

logger.title: Create structured log events with VersaTul.Logger
logger.description: Create structured log events independent of the delivery target with VersaTul.Logger. Share log levels and a common payload across file, mail, and web sinks.

logger-file.title: Write rolling file logs with VersaTul.Logger.File
logger-file.description: Write rolling diagnostic logs to disk with VersaTul.Logger.File. Add rotation and archiving for services and batch jobs without managing file growth in application code.

logger-mail.title: Send operational log alerts with VersaTul.Logger.Mail
logger-mail.description: Send operational log events by email with VersaTul.Logger.Mail. Batch and throttle notifications, retry delivery, and route failed messages to a dead-letter queue.

logger-web.title: Forward structured logs over HTTP with VersaTul.Logger.Web
logger-web.description: Forward structured logs to an HTTP endpoint with VersaTul.Logger.Web. Send JSON to an API or collector while application code uses the shared ILogger contract.

mailer.title: Send templated email with VersaTul.Mailer
mailer.description: Send plain-text or HTML email with attachments and token templates using VersaTul.Mailer. Keep SMTP settings and dispatch separate from calling workflows.

converters.title: Convert objects to key/value data with VersaTul.Object.Converters
converters.description: Convert .NET objects, nested dictionaries, and enumerables into key/value data with VersaTul.Object.Converters. Prepare values for reports, exports, and formatting.

pipeline-infrastructure.title: Compose typed processing steps with VersaTul.Pipeline.Infrastructure
pipeline-infrastructure.description: Compose synchronous or asynchronous transformations into reusable steps with VersaTul.Pipeline.Infrastructure. Build typed pipelines without a larger orchestration framework.

scheduler.title: Schedule background jobs with VersaTul.Task.Scheduler
scheduler.description: Schedule recurring and one-off .NET background jobs with VersaTul.Task.Scheduler. Combine calendar and interval schedules for services and worker processes.

utilities.title: Convert values safely with VersaTul.Utilities
utilities.description: Handle conversions, null values, DBNull, and shared helper operations with VersaTul.Utilities. Reuse foundational helpers used across VersaTul library packages.
